{{Quote|Locked 'n' loaded, Wedge! This baby's ready to smash ''anythin''' that flies!|Griff|<ref name="Dark Empire II 4">[[Dark Empire II 4|''Dark Empire II'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Griff''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served as a member of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. He participated in the [[Battle of the Emperor's Citadel]] where he operated the weapons aboard an [[X-1 Viper]] commanded by [[General/Legends|Generals]] [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]].
